about.title: About me
about.description: I'm just a programmer who loves creating things. I enjoy experimenting and testing ideas outside the ordinary. I have a passion for technical challenges and problem-solving, as well as a strong desire to learn and grow. I'm always looking for new opportunities to expand my knowledge and skills, and I'm excited to see what the future has in store for me.
